# Numbers First

> Numbers First (numberfirst.pro) provides outsourced accounting, bookkeeping and financial advisory for small and medium businesses across Saudi Arabia. It offers two distinct solutions: Accounting & Bookkeeping, and Financial Planning & Advisory. The site is available in English (/en) and Arabic (/ar).

## Key facts

- Service area: small and medium businesses across Saudi Arabia
- Languages: English and Arabic
- Pricing: fixed monthly fees from SAR 1,000 to SAR 5,000, set by balance-sheet value; fees exclude 15% VAT; backlog clean-up and system setup are quoted as a one-off fee
- Getting started: free assessment, then a written fixed-fee proposal, 14-day onboarding, and monthly delivery with a review call
- Response time: within one working day
- Contact: phone and WhatsApp +966 59 856 5877; email info@numberfirst.pro

## Solution 1: Accounting & Bookkeeping

- Monthly bookkeeping: every transaction recorded, reconciled and closed each month
- VAT, Zakat and e-invoicing: returns prepared and filed on time; invoicing connected to ZATCA's Fatoora platform
- Payroll and WPS: salary processing and Mudad compliance, including end-of-service calculations
- Management reports: monthly P&L, balance sheet and cash-flow pack

### Packages (per month, excluding VAT)

- Starter, SAR 1,000: balance sheet under SAR 500K, or under 100 sales transactions. Monthly bookkeeping, quarterly VAT return, annual Zakat filing
- Standard, SAR 2,000: balance sheet SAR 500K to 1M. Monthly bookkeeping, payroll up to 10 staff (WPS), monthly P&L
- Growth, SAR 3,500: balance sheet SAR 1M to 3M. Monthly bookkeeping, ZATCA e-invoicing support, payroll up to 25 staff, budget and monthly reports
- Premium, SAR 5,000: balance sheet above SAR 3M. Everything in Growth, cash-flow forecast, CFO-lite review, audit liaison and board pack

## Solution 2: Financial Planning & Advisory

- Budgeting and forecasting reviewed against actuals every month
- Pricing and margin decisions
- Lease and expansion decisions
- Profitability by branch (revenue, EBITDA and net profit by month)
- CFO-lite review with recommended actions
- Audit liaison and board pack

### Industry focus

Sports & Fitness; Real Estate; Food & Beverage (F&B); Hospitality; Consultancy; Design & Creative businesses.

### Monthly financial outlook pack

Profitability by branch, a detailed monthly P&L with every cost line and margin, and a conclusion with recommended actions.

## Saudi compliance quick facts (as answered on the site)

- VAT registration is mandatory above SAR 375,000 of taxable supplies in 12 months; voluntary above SAR 187,500; standard rate 15%
- VAT returns are monthly for annual taxable supplies above SAR 40 million, otherwise quarterly; due by the last day of the month after the period
- The annual Zakat return is filed with ZATCA within 120 days of the financial year-end
- ZATCA e-invoicing: Phase 1 (Generation) since 4 December 2021; Phase 2 (Integration with the Fatoora platform) rolled out in waves, with at least six months' notice from ZATCA

## Sectors served

Healthcare; Retail and e-commerce; Hospitality; Food and beverage; Sports and fitness; Consulting; Design and workspaces.
